limitations: Battery level, charging state and power management do not work: the battery device reports no data because the audio/battery processor (ADSP) does not start. The cause is understood (a device-tree workaround keeps the GEM NoC disabled, and the image has no firmware for this exact machine) and is described in the release notes.
No sound: the same ADSP dependency; no sound card appears.
Graphics are software-rendered (llvmpipe) on a firmware framebuffer; there is no GPU acceleration.
Wi-Fi does not recover after suspend and resume; suspend and resume are not claimed.
Camera and USB-C power delivery are not claimed. Touchpad works in basic mouse mode only (polling driver).
RAR is extract-only (UnRAR licence). Wine, Waydroid and QEMU are not included.
The standalone mpv configuration change (Wayland context) was not verified.
Helium and Zen are unmodified third-party releases; their trademark and artwork terms were not reviewed separately and the Helium signing key is not otherwise certified.
Browser sandboxes need unprivileged user namespaces; the image sets kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0.
Boot loader and kernel images are unsigned; Secure Boot must be off. The downloads are signed (SHA256SUMS.asc).
No vendor firmware is included. Default live accounts are those of the development image (user live, password live).
Arch Linux ARM publishes no explicit redistribution statement; the maintainer acceptance of the three-year written source offer is recorded at release approval.
